inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic cinematic film, 35mm with natural grain, warm tungsten work lamps and a cool blue glow from the gadget, rain streaking the dark skylight, real unretouched skin with visible pores. Keep exactly the faces and costumes of the two men in <Picture 1>; their faces must stay the same people in every frame. The pirate: red patterned bandana, dark deep-set eyes, hollow cheeks, long pointed dark goatee and thin moustache, silver hoop earring, long dark dreadlocks threaded with colourful beads, weathered brown leather coat. The inventor: wild shaggy grey-white hair, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, very wide pale-blue eyes, short dark beard and moustache, grey work shirt under a stained white lab coat. Normal real-time speed, no slow motion. The inventor (S1) has an excitable, quick, energetic male voice. The pirate (S2) has a deep, gravelly male voice with a dry, teasing edge. One continuous five-second shot: the camera pushes slowly forward past the hanging cables toward the workbench. From the first frame the inventor is hunched over the glowing gadget; his wide eyes flick up, and without turning around the inventor (S1) says: "You're late. It's already awake." The pirate pushes off the door frame and strolls toward the bench, thumbs hooked in his belt, smirking, and the pirate (S2) says: "Machines don't wake up, Doc." The inventor turns his head toward him with a slow, delighted grin.

overall_soundscape: Rain drums on the glass skylight, a low electrical hum comes from the gadget and a soft crackle from the Tesla coil in the back; the pirate's boots knock on the wooden floor, his beads click softly, and a small tool clinks on the bench as the inventor sets it down.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
